keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Serginho (Levski Sofia).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Levski Sofia 0, Jagiellonia Białystok 0.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Yuki Kobayashi replaces Dusan Stojinovic.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Armstrong Oko-Flex replaces Serginho because of an injury.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Ousmane Sow replaces Jeremy Agbonifo.
Second Half begins Levski Sofia 0, Jagiellonia Białystok 0.
Guilherme Montóia (Jagiellonia Białystok) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Stivan Stoyanchov replaces Mazire Soula.
Delay in match (Jagiellonia Białystok).
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Aleksandar Cirkovic replaces Kajetan Szmyt.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Everton Bala (Levski Sofia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. David Kusso replaces Everton Bala.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Eryk Kozlowski replaces Anders Klynge.
Taras Romanczuk (Jagiellonia Białystok) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Levski Sofia 1, Jagiellonia Białystok 0. Stivan Stoyanchov (Levski Sofia) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by David Kusso with a cross following a corner.
Stivan Stoyanchov (Levski Sofia) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Kamil Józwiak replaces Jesús Imaz.
Jesús Imaz (Jagiellonia Białystok) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Levski Sofia. Gasper Trdin replaces Reinaldo.
David Kusso (Levski Sofia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Levski Sofia 1, Jagiellonia Białystok 0.
